items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: So it was Greg Phillinganes... Al Aarons from Basie’s band playing trumpet. I was playing another keyboard.

ctx.x: So the day we were going to do it Joe was sick so he wasn’t there in the studio. So it was Greg Phillinganes, who is a wonderful synth keyboard player. I forget who else, Al Aarons from Basie’s band playing trumpet. I was playing another keyboard. I forget who the rest of the rhythm section was. And I wrote a chart, like horns, saxophone sounds and everything. So Joe comes in like a week later and boy he sounds great. So I get a call from John Levy, his manager, he says, “Joe wanted to see if he could use that…
yeah it’s easy, the chart’s there, I mean the chart’s all written on scratch paper, we just used —” So I went and wrote this chart. It sounded exactly the same.
